text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Post time was drawing near, so I was about 
to call out to Durandal, but—
choice_data_list:
(I can sense something like a huge blade 
on the other side of the door...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: （巨大な刃のような気配がドア越しに……）
choice_data_list_en: (I can feel a presence like a massive blade through the door...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. But during the race, my own 
body, my very legs become the holy sword.
choice_data_list: ……聖剣がそこに見えるような気さえするな
……聖剣がそこに見えるような気さえするね
choice_data_list_en: ...I feel like I can almost see the holy sword right there.
...I feel like I can almost see the holy sword right there.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
All who dare stand in my way shall be 
swept aside by my run.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Victory for my master. I pray that you 
bear witness.
